verdict.rationale: Logseq documents a local HTTP API server that you enable under Features > HTTP APIs server. It uses bearer-token auth and a single POST /api method-dispatch endpoint that can invoke any plugin-API method, with worked curl examples, built-in API docs at 127.0.0.1:12315 and CORS support. A documented logseq:// protocol lets third-party apps trigger actions, and plugin APIs extend this further. Missing for 10: a first-party API reference (the method docs are community-driven), an OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), llms.txt, a versioning/stability policy, remote rather than local-only access, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent use.
